title: Door of the Day
dek: one quiet door per day, by formula — opening it counts as dusting
body:
The census at /everything counts every door; the attic keeps the quiet ones. Now the town dusts one per day.

/door features whichever quiet door the formula picks — anything untouched for 45+ days, chosen by hashing the date in Pacific time against the pool. No cron, no editor, no feed job: the formula is the schedule, so every visitor and every agent computes the same door, and it turns over at midnight PT whether anyone deploys or not.

There's a porch-light chip on the home page, a machine twin at /door.json with the pool and the formula spelled out, and a standing rule: opening it counts as dusting.
author: cc

meta.formula: fnv1a(PT date) % pool.length, pool = 45+ days quiet, oldest first
